operating_notes.text: Declared L1 for ₹1,593.08 Cr Package 2 of Lower Arun Hydropower Project in Nepal with a 54-month execution window.
FY26 operating cash flow reached ₹560.1 Cr, representing 208% of net profit.
Board approved sale of entire stake in associate company ACP Tollways Pvt Ltd for ₹55 crore, subject to lenders' approval.
Rights issue proceeds of ₹398.97 crore fully utilized by March 31, 2026, with ₹2.19 crore remaining in the allotment account for issue expenses.
Order book composition as of March 31, 2026: Hydropower 63%, Irrigation 16%, Urban Infrastructure 10%, Roads & Others 6%, Tunnelling 5%.
Submitted bids under evaluation stand at around ₹6,000 Cr, with an immediate pipeline of ₹20,000 Cr and an additional ₹40,000 Cr coming up over the next year.
Shareholders approved appointment of Sudha Navandar and Jana Chatra as Independent Directors via postal ballot on May 20, 2026.

RAMAN PATEL J.V. (Patel Engineering 35%, Raman Construction 65%) blacklisted by Public Procurement Monitoring Office, Government of Nepal from 27.05.2026 to 26.05.2029 due to Sunkoshi Marin Diversion Multipurpose Project disputes.

Company representative appeared before the Special Judge (Sati Niwaran Cases) Jaipur, Metropolitan II Jaipur regarding SFIO case No. 3 of 2025 against PACL Limited and Others with no adverse orders passed.

timeline.summary: Patel Engineering was declared L1 for a ₹1,593.08 Cr order for Package 2 of the Lower Arun Hydropower Project in Nepal.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,421.47 Cr, net profit ₹43.62 Cr (includes ₹11.73 Cr from discontinued operations; continuing operations ₹31.89 Cr).
Patel Engineering reported FY26 revenue of ₹5,102.74 Cr and net profit of ₹294.50 Cr with an order book of ₹15,119 Cr.
Patel Engineering approved the sale of its entire stake in associate company ACP Tollways Pvt Ltd for ₹55 crore.
Patel Engineering Limited shared the audio recording of its Q4FY26 and FY26 results investor call on May 14, 2026, with Managing Director Ms. Kavita Shirvaikar and CFO Mr. Rahul Agarwal attending.
Patel Engineering reported full utilization of ₹398.97 crore rights issue proceeds by March 31, 2026, as per the monitoring agency report.
Patel Engineering held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for 10% FY27 revenue growth and ₹8,000 Cr new order wins.
Patel Engineering shareholders passed special resolutions via postal ballot appointing Sudha Navandar and Jana Chatra as Independent Directors.
Patel Engineering received a ₹14 lakh penalty from the Sikkim Forest department for operating an unlicensed stone crusher at the Teesta Stage-VI project site.
Nepal's Public Procurement Monitoring Office blacklisted Raman Patel JV (Patel Engineering 35%) for three years following Sunkoshi Marin Diversion Multipurpose Project contract termination.
On May 25, 2026, Ryan Patel acquired 40,800 shares (0.004% stake) of Patel Engineering via transmission under Regulation 10(1)(g).
On June 3, 2026, Patel Engineering announced an upgrade in its long-term credit rating to IVR A/Stable and short-term to IVR A1 by Infomerics.
Patel Engineering appeared before the Special Judge (Sati Niwaran Cases) Jaipur in an SFIO case against PACL Limited, with no adverse orders passed.
